spec.name: sprint35_taker_imbalance_megacap_liquid
spec.hypothesis: Trailing 5-min taker buy/sell volume imbalance >65/35 predicts 15-min directional continuation in top-liquidity large-caps, net of realistic costs (T1 spreads).
spec.power_argument: 10-symbol liquid basket (AAPL,MSFT,NVDA,AMZN,GOOGL,META,AVGO,JPM,V,XOM), entry_per_day_cap=6/symbol => up to 60/day; ~15 trading sessions remain => up to 900 trade opportunities, floor >=300 even at 33% fire rate. Min detectable edge sized to realized T1 costs (~5-10bps half-spread from prior fills) => need >=15bps gross edge to clear 2x-cost bar at t>=2.
